prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent SPRITE SHEET for an SSS limited 2D RPG swordsman's battle visual effect. Every effect isolated inside its own cell with generous 10% transparent padding, nothing crossing cell boundaries. Same scale, camera and pivot across all frames. Actual clean alpha transparency, no checkerboard painting or opaque background. Coherent premium hand-painted anime game VFX, sharp shapes, intricate fine particle detail, controlled platinum-white, muted gold edge sparks, black/grey depth. BACKGROUND BATTLE PRESSURE LOOP. Twelve successive animation phases of subtle distant air slashes and floating dust caused by a human master swordsman's presence. A wide sparse arrangement of thin diagonal white-silver wind lines at corners, very small warm gold sparks and dark stone dust drifting diagonally; large central empty area so fighters remain readable. No closed shapes, no circular halo, runes, crosses, wing shapes or weapons. Each successive frame moves/deforms the actual wind and dust, soft buildup then falloff returning close to original state. Layer behind fighters, only sparse edges not a background painting. Generate an actual evolution of forms frame-by-frame, never the identical static effect repeated with just opacity. No characters, anatomy, UI, religious symbols, rune rings or magic sigils.
